test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Ravi buys salt at ₹16 per kg and sells it at ₹18 per kg. He also uses the weight of 900 gm instead of 1000 gm. What is Ravi's actual profit percentage?
solution:
**Given:**

Ravi buys salt at ₹16 per kg and sells it at ₹18 per kg. He also uses the weight of 900 gm instead of 1000 gm.

**Calculations:**

When he sells 1 kg = 1000gm

Actual quantity he gave = 900gm.

SP = 1000(18) = 18000

Effective CP = 900(16) = 14400

Hence, profit % = ((SP - CP)/CP) × 100

= ((18000 - 14400)/14400)100 

= (3600/14400)100 = 25%

**Hence, The Required value is 25%.**
